contract.baseline: UNRUN candidate: native upstream selection / hardware feature path; not a B200-specific optimization claim
contract.input_generation: CPU fp32 generator seed20261020+shape_index, then CPU cast to true requested input dtype
contract.timed_scope: Only original wrapped Triton kernel launch into existing preallocated C; no public Python allocator/native Torch GPU compute/backward
contract.source_transform: No source edits and no .fn unwrapping; original decorators/tuning/pre-hooks retained
contract.fp8_policy: True float8 input and output. Dot operators use native float8 tl.dot with fp32 accumulator; no harness fp16 substitution. Convolution computes fp32 from float8 storage; cache only copies storage.
contract.precision_validation: FP32 IEEE tl.dot allow_tf32=False explicit at every selected dot; independent CPU fp64 reference. FP32 matrix tolerance rtol2e-5/atol1e-4 prespecified for K<=512, not changed in response to observations.
contract.metadata: A5 group row counts converted to cumulative row ends outside timing; int32 ends counted as reads
contract.entrypoint: flag_gems.ops.group_gemm.grouped_mm_tma_kernel with original 7-config LibTuner and descriptor block-shape pre-hook
contract.launch: Upstream tuner selects config at first correctness/warmup call; record actual compiled metadata after serial gate
contract.native_TMA_metadata: Three host descriptors; block shapes set by original per-config pre-hook; construction outside timing; launch-side pre-hook remains original. No staging FP16 conversion.
contract.dispatch_evidence: Exact public group_mm gate: supports_tma(capability major>=9) and host TensorDescriptor available. Preallocated C replaces public output allocation; descriptors created outside timing.
contract.hardware_feature_classification: SM90+ TMA hardware-feature path, not B200-exclusive; actual TMA lowering must be evidenced by root compile/IR gate
contract.candidate_status: CPU/source-only prepared; not compiled, numerically validated, or timed by audit agent
contract.same_contract: Existing baseline cpu_inputs/device_inputs/outputs/refs/tolerances/traffic and FP8 storage retained exactly. FP32 dot explicitly allow_tf32=False in unchanged upstream kernels.

sources.role: Native wrapper/config selection, exact official source; no claim of B200-specific tuning
